what_it_is.prose: Adani Defence & Aerospace is the UAV manufacturing arm of the Adani Group, operating India's first private UAV manufacturing facility in Hyderabad through a JV with Israel's Elbit Systems. It manufactures the Hermes 900 MALE UAV (Indian designation: Drishti-10 Starliner) for the Indian Navy and Army under a ~US$300M contract, and has expanded into indigenous loitering munitions (Agnikaa VTOL-1, SR-1) and ULPGM precision munitions delivered to the Indian Army. While licence-assembling Israeli platforms has drawn criticism over indigenous content, the company has become a cornerstone of India's MALE-UAV capacity and was the supplier of the country's first indigenously manufactured MALE drone delivered in January 2024.

faq.question: Is Adani Defence & Aerospace a separately listed company?
faq.answer: No. Adani Defence & Aerospace is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Adani Enterprises Ltd (NSE: ADANIENT, BSE: 512599), the flagship listed entity of the Adani Group.

faq.question: What is the Drishti-10 Starliner UAV?
faq.answer: Drishti-10 Starliner is the Indian designation of the Elbit Hermes 900 MALE UAV, licence-manufactured by Adani Defence & Aerospace at its Adani-Elbit UAV complex in Hyderabad. The first India-made unit was delivered to the Indian Navy in January 2024 under a ~US$300M contract for ~12 systems.

faq.question: Which kamikaze drone did Adani Defence deliver to the Indian Army?
faq.answer: Adani Defence delivered the Agnikaa VTOL-1, India's first FPV kamikaze drone in its class, along with DRDO-developed ULPGM (UAV-Launched Precision Guided Munition) systems, to the Indian Army under emergency procurement.
